title: Will the World Hit 2°C Before 2050? Class Model vs Kalshi

s1.description: The question, why compare a model with a market, and the three-part plan.

s2.description: Part 1: how Kalshi gets its number, from the contract and order book to a fair probability range.

s3.description: Part 2: how we get our number, from the class model to a probability density, compared with Kalshi and the IPCC.

s4.description: Part 3: what we could hypothetically do with the numbers, and what changes if you believe X.

s5.description: What we learned, what the model can’t do, and a bonus on the social cost of carbon.
